summary:
Abandoned but Not Forgotten

Our project, "Abandoned but Not Forgotten," is a digital storytelling platform that highlights NASAs discarded and abandoned equipment on the Moon and Mars. It explores the history and purpose of these objects, explaining why they were left behind and their importance in space exploration. Through an engaging web-based experience, users can discover the stories behind spacecraft, landers, rovers, and other equipment. Our goal is to make space history interesting, interactive, and educational for students and space enthusiasts. This project helps people understand that even abandoned objects have valuable stories to tell and represent important milestones in humanity's journey to explore space.
details:
Abandoned but Not Forgotten

Our project, "Abandoned but Not Forgotten," is an interactive digital storytelling platform that explores NASA's abandoned equipment on the Moon and Mars.

The platform helps users discover different space exploration objects, such as rovers, landers, spacecraft, and scientific instruments. It explains their purpose, history, missions, and why they were left behind. Users can explore the information through an engaging website with images, descriptions, and interactive storytelling.

How it works: Users visit our website and explore different abandoned space objects to learn about their missions and historical importance.

Benefits and Impact: This project makes space exploration history easier to understand, increases awareness of NASA's missions, and encourages students to learn more about science and space technology.

Technologies Used: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and 3D visualization tools.

Creativity: We combine storytelling, visual design, and interactive web experiences to turn forgotten space equipment into interesting stories. Our goal is to show that every abandoned object has a story worth remembering.
